item.title: Jensen Huang affair in D.C.: Resignation calls and moves to tighten Nvidia China exports
item.description:
Members of Congress are calling on [Nvidia](https://www.cnbc.com/quotes/NVDA/) CEO [Jensen Huang](https://www.cnbc.com/jensen-huang/) to resign, and momentum is building to subpoena the executive, whose company is a leader in advanced [artificial intelligence](https://www.cnbc.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/) chips.
Huang, who leads a company that’s been a chief beneficiary of the artificial intelligence boom, on Sunday admitted to having an [affair](https://www.cnbc.com/video/2026/11/09/huang-affair-was-not-on-my-bingo-card-panmures-klement.html) with a woman whom news outlets have reported U.S. intelligence concluded was a [Chinese spy](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/10/nvidia-wachtell-lipton-huang-affair.html).

item.title: Who Is Alice Huang, the Woman in the Middle of Nvidia’s Spy Scandal?
Nvidia CEO’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy could be a problem for the economy
item.description:
His signature leather jacket, frequent media appearances and close relationship with President Donald Trump made Huang one of the most iconic CEOs of the artificial intelligence era, providing computer chips and financing that have helped sustain an [economic boom](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/07/31/tech-giants-burning-cash-ai-create-risks-whole-economy/) that has lifted millions of [investment and retirement accounts](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/08/20/ai-is-increasing-inequality-economists-hedge-fund-leaders-warn/).
Nvidia’s powerful computer chips, crucial to AI development, are “the lifeblood” of the global artificial intelligence industry, said Ben Buchanan, a White House special adviser on AI under President Joe Biden.
